description: Use this when the user asks how a player's team does with him on or off the floor, his clutch or garbage-time splits, or how he plays with or without a teammate (NFL: target, carry and red-zone shares with or without a teammate). Returns those splits for the season. Requires Keel Stats Pro; the answer says so when the account has none.

player_id.description: Numeric player ID from the search tool.

season.description: Optional season year. Defaults to the current season.

teammate_id.description: Optional numeric teammate player ID to drill into specific two-man / with-without splits.

name: player_splits_and_on_off
title: Player Splits, On/Off & Teammates (Pro)
